text: If every copy of one or two letters were filler, striking them out moves the known words. 0057 found a repeating key of 24 or 25 letters could then fit, as often as by chance. Such a key fixes most of the message: does what it fixes read as English?

For each of 351 choices of filler and each fitting setting, the readings at the places the key fixes, outside the known words, searched for dictionary words of 6 letters or more; the same on ten scrambled copies.
K4's readings hold no such word at all; the copies' hold 0 to 32. F2.1 closed.
